add_action('wp_head', function(){ ?>
<style>
:root{--paper:#f4f0e8;--ink:#171713;--pine:#1f4d47;--steel:#6f6a62;--rule:#d4cec3}
html,body{background:var(--paper)!important;color:var(--ink)!important}
.lab{max-width:1120px;margin:auto;padding:48px 28px 80px}.lab h1{font:500 clamp(3rem,7vw,6rem)/.94 Outfit,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.045em;margin:.3em 0}.lab p{max-width:680px;color:var(--steel);font:400 1.08rem/1.55 Outfit,system-ui,sans-serif}.labgrid{margin-top:64px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 380px;gap:48px;min-height:340px;padding:38px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);align-items:center}.copy h2{font:460 clamp(2.2rem,4vw,3.4rem)/1 Newsreader,Georgia,serif;margin:.35em 0}.tag{font:600 .7rem/1 Outfit,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--pine)}
.stage{height:300px;position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;perspective:1000px;overflow:hidden}.axis{width:1px;height:210px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(31,77,71,.8),transparent);position:absolute}.obj{width:160px;height:160px;position:relative;transform-style:preserve-3d;animation:spin 12s linear infinite}.ring{position:absolute;inset:12px;border:1px solid rgba(31,77,71,.72);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(31,77,71,.12)}.r2{inset:28px;transform:rotateX(70deg)}.r3{inset:2px;transform:rotateY(70deg)}.core{position:absolute;inset:54px;border:1px solid rgba(31,77,71,.9);background:rgba(31,77,71,.04);box-shadow:0 0 35px rgba(31,77,71,.15),inset 0 0 18px rgba(31,77,71,.12)}.scan{position:absolute;left:4px;right:4px;height:1px;top:30%;background:rgba(31,77,71,.8);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(31,77,71,.5);animation:scan 3s ease-in-out infinite}.glitch{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.2;animation:glitch 7s steps(1,end) infinite}.glitch:before,.glitch:after{content:'';position:absolute;left:15%;right:15%;height:1px;background:rgba(31,77,71,.7)}.glitch:before{top:35%}.glitch:after{top:66%}.floor{position:absolute;width:170px;height:30px;border:1px solid rgba(31,77,71,.22);border-radius:50%;bottom:24px;transform:rotateX(70deg)}
.row:nth-child(2) .core{border-radius:10px;transform:translateZ(18px)}.row:nth-child(2) .ring{border-radius:14%}.row:nth-child(3) .r2{transform:rotateY(70deg)}.row:nth-child(3) .r3{transform:rotateX(70deg) rotateY(25deg)}.row:nth-child(3) .core{border-radius:50%}.row:nth-child(4) .core{inset:42px 54px;transform:translateZ(25px)}.row:nth-child(4) .r3{transform:rotateY(65deg)}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotateY(360deg) rotateX(5deg)}}@keyframes scan{0%,100%{top:25%;opacity:.25}50%{top:75%;opacity:.9}}@keyframes glitch{0%,88%,100%{transform:none;opacity:.15}89%{transform:translateX(4px) skewX(7deg);opacity:.75}90%{transform:translateX(-3px);opacity:.35}}
@media(max-width:800px){.row{grid-template-columns:1fr}.stage{height:250px;order:2}.copy{order:1}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.obj,.scan,.glitch{animation:none}.obj{transform:rotateY(28deg) rotateX(5deg)}}
</style>
<?php });
